name: An early retiree with large gains: contributions and the Günstigerprüfung
workings: Income for health: 60,000 × 70% + 2,000 = 44,000, between the minimum and the 69,750 ceiling
Health 16.9% × 44,000 = 7,436.00; care 4.2% = 1,848.00; prepare charged the minimum (2,673.58 and 664.44), assess adds the rest
Tariff: 43,000 − 9,284 − 36 = 33,680.00; T = 5,278.114565, lower, so the Günstigerprüfung applies
